desc: Ideation complete: identify digit-length generating function, inverse-binomial weighting, and candidate recurrence/NTT approaches.
Parse N; compute for each digit length d the count c_d and sum S_d of numbers in [1,N] with that length; set q_d=10^d modulo 998244353.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N, and invC[m]=1/C(N-1,m) for m=0..N-1.
Derive and implement the small-degree differential recurrence for P(z)=∏(1+q_d z)^{c_d} to compute coefficients p_0..p_N in O(N·#lengths).
For each present digit length d, recover coefficients of P_d(z)=P(z)/(1+q_d z) via p^d_0=1 and p^d_m=p_m-q_d·p^d_{m-1}, then compute T_d=∑_{m=0}^{N-1} p^d_m·invC[m] modulo 998244353.
Validate the implementation against sample inputs 3, 390, and 79223.
